title: Peggy's Cove and Swissair Memorial Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the breathtaking beauty of Nova Scotia with an unforgettable Peggy’s Cove tour from Halifax. Travel along the scenic South Shore and discover the world-famous Peggy’s Point Lighthouse, perched on rugged granite rocks overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Explore the charming fishing village, take stunning coastal photos, and experience the peaceful beauty that has made Peggy’s Cove one of Canada’s most iconic destinations.

Enjoy a comfortable small-group experience, local insight from a knowledgeable guide, and stops along the way showcasing hidden coastal views, local history, and the true charm of Nova Scotia. Perfect for cruise ship visitors, families, couples, and anyone looking to experience the best of the East Coast.
